improvements.title: Default provider should auto-fallback to OpenRouter when its key is set
improvements.description: When no provider is specified and Google API is not configured, Pi should check for OPENROUTER_API_KEY and use it as a fallback. This would improve UX for users who only have OpenRouter credentials.

improvements.title: Model ID normalization for OpenRouter prefix syntax
improvements.description: Model IDs with slashes (openrouter/provider/model) are currently passed as-is to OpenRouter. Consider normalizing to just provider/model to align with OpenRouter's native format and reduce API confusion.

improvements.title: Provider fallback chain documentation
improvements.description: Document the provider selection precedence clearly: explicit --provider flag > provider prefix in --model > default provider > fallback providers.

divergences.title: Default provider selection lacks fallback logic
divergences.expected: When GOOGLE_API_KEY is missing, Pi should check OPENROUTER_API_KEY and use it as fallback
divergences.observed: Pi fails with authentication error when Google credentials are missing, even when OpenRouter is configured
divergences.impact: Users without Google credentials but with OpenRouter setup must explicitly specify --provider openrouter for every call

divergences.title: xAI/Grok models unavailable via OpenRouter
divergences.expected: Grok-4 model should be routable via openrouter/x-ai/grok-4 prefix
divergences.observed: Model returns 'not available' or 'not found' error
divergences.impact: xAI models cannot be accessed through Pi's OpenRouter integration on this account
